2. **Data & Operational freshness at 8 vs peer median of 94 — the widest gap** — an 86-point deficit driven by 14 stale entities and no fresh data in the system; this is the single most impactful area to address. [→ §peer]
3. **Engagement at 30 vs peer median of 70** — a 40-point gap reflecting minimal login and ordering activity; only 2 of 5 users logged in within 90 days. [→ §peer]
4. **Trajectory at 60 vs peer median of 80 — the narrowest gap** — the 20-point difference suggests some forward momentum, the closest dimension to peer norms. [→ §peer]
5. **Top performers operate at feature depth 4–5 with 12–44 orders** — Kaleen's feature depth of 2 and 1 order places it far below the comparable benchmark for successful accounts. [→ §peer]

## Priority Action Candidate
